这几年你把心思都放在了功课上，作业本上的红勾越来越多，老师也常常表扬你。: These past years your mind was on your schoolwork. The red ticks in your exercise books multiplied, and teachers often praised you.
这几年你几乎把所有时间都给了书本。台灯下的夜晚很长，成绩单上的名次一点点往前挪。: These past years you gave nearly all your time to books. The nights under the desk lamp were long, and your place on the report card crept upward.
这几年你一直在给自己充电。学到的东西不声不响，却在一次次机会面前派上了用场。: These past years you kept building your skills. What you learned made no noise, but it came through whenever a chance appeared.
这几年你没停下学习：下班后的网课、周末的证书班。同事们开始有问题就来问你。: These past years you never stopped learning: online courses after work, certificate classes at weekends. Colleagues began coming to you with their questions.
这几年你像个老学生一样学这学那，脑子越用越灵，连孙辈都夸你\"跟得上时代\"。: These past years you studied this and that like an old student. Your mind grew sharper with use, and even your grandchildren said you "keep up with the times".
这几年你玩得很尽兴：田野、街巷、操场，到处都留下了你和伙伴们的笑声。: These past years you played to the full. Fields, lanes and playgrounds all rang with your laughter and your friends'.
这几年你一直坚持着自己的爱好。它不能当饭吃，却让日子有了光。: These past years you stuck with your hobby. It didn't put food on the table, but it brought light to your days.
这几年你身边的朋友越来越多。遇到难处时，总有人第一时间站出来。: These past years your circle of friends kept growing. When trouble came, someone always stepped up first.
这几年你把很多时间留给了家人。饭桌上的话多了，家里的笑声也多了。: These past years you kept much of your time for family. There was more talk at the table, and more laughter in the house.
这几年你认真地对待感情，学会了倾听，也学会了表达。: These past years you took love seriously, learning to listen and learning to say what you felt.
这几年你一门心思扑在工作上，加班成了常态。收入和职位都在往上走，只是陪家人的时间: These past years you threw yourself into work, and overtime became normal. Your pay and position kept rising; only the time with family shrank.
这几年你精打细算，每个月雷打不动地先存下一笔钱。账户里的数字慢慢变厚，你心里也越: These past years you counted every coin, putting money aside first thing each month without fail. The number in the account slowly grew, and you felt steadier for it.
这几年你一直很注意身体：按时作息、坚持运动、定期体检。镜子里的自己精神了不少。: These past years you took care of your body: regular hours, steady exercise, routine check-ups. The person in the mirror looked a good deal livelier.
这几年你有意放慢了脚步，不再和别人比快慢。睡得好了，笑得也多了。: These past years you deliberately slowed down and stopped racing against others. You slept better, and you laughed more.
这几年你常常回去陪父母：陪他们看病、说话、吃饭。他们老了，也因为有你，老得从容一: These past years you often went back to be with your parents: taking them to the doctor, talking, sharing meals. They grew old, and because of you, they grew old with more ease.
这几年你把很多时间给了孩子：接送、陪读、讲睡前故事。孩子长得飞快，你都记在心里。: These past years you gave much of your time to your children: school runs, homework, bedtime stories. They grew up fast, and you kept all of it in your heart.
这几年你常常去帮助别人。你没想过要回报，可身边的人都记着你的好。: These past years you often went out of your way to help others. You never thought about getting anything back, but the people around you remembered your kindness.
